# Landing Page Generator - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
SaaS platform for AI-powered landing page generation from product images.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14 (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Prisma + PostgreSQL
- OpenAI API for AI generation
- Shadcn/ui components

## Key Features
- Multi-step wizard interface
- AI-powered content generation
- Real-time landing page preview
- Product and image management
- Customizable color palettes
- Drag & drop functionality
- Dark professional UI theme

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript strict mode
- Follow React best practices
- Implement responsive design
- Optimize for performance
- Use server components when possible
- Maintain clean code architecture
